KCN Sài Đồng B có diện tích là 96ha, với.en: KNNN B has an area of 96ha, with a 100% fill rate. A number of major investors at KNNNNN B Coalition Company is the ONH Metal ORAN HI, the SUMI-HEL Wikinews Company, the NHHH HICH Company,... With specialized industries such as the Electronic Industrial, Automotives, Engineering, High Technology,... The infrastructure at KNN Saigon B was also constructed quite early and revised. With the internal traffic system there's a 26 m main route and a 20-foot subway. Power source 110/35/22KV, clean water systems at 10,000 m3 per day and 3,000m/day waste disposal system. As a result of this convenience, the Rutland B Industrial Zone received interest from major investors.
KCN Sài Đồng B có diện tích là 96ha, với.zh: KNNN B的面积为96ha,填充率为100%. KNNNNN B联盟公司的一些主要投资者是ONH金属ORAN HI,SUMI-HEL Wikinews公司,NHH Hich公司,...... 拥有电子工业,汽车,工程,高技术等专业产业,. KNN Sigon B的基础设施也建造得相当早并经过了修订。 与内地交通系统相接有26米干道和20英尺地铁. 动力源110/35/22KV,净水系统为每天10000立方米,垃圾处理系统为每天3000m. 由于这种方便,拉特兰B工业区获得了主要投资者的利息.
